target_customer: AI labs and enterprises that need evaluation benchmarks and training datasets built by experts
problem: Frontier models and enterprise deployments need high quality expert built evals and training data that generic annotation vendors cannot supply.
business_model: Services and data sales to AI labs (project based dataset and benchmark development)
product_category: Expert data development for AI evaluation and training

founders.name: Robi Lin
founders.background_notes: Scaled Turing's LLM trainer business from 50 to over 800 developers in five months, per the YC page. Also written Robert Lin in other sources.

founders.name: Kat Hu
founders.background_notes: Built go to market for Turing's foundational LLM trainer business and ran organizations of 500 or more AI trainers.

founders.name: Fedor Paretsky
founders.role: Early engineer and co-founder per Seedtable
founders.background_notes: YC lists him as a team member rather than founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly an operations and talent sourcing business with some dataset tooling; the hard part was recruiting domain experts and quality control rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: An expert network of 20,000 or more people and lab relationships help, but experts and customers were shared with well funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Mercor, a larger expert marketplace, acquired Sepal on February 6, 2026.

market_need_then: AI labs were buying expert generated data and evals at growing volume in 2024, evidenced by the rapid growth of vendors in the space; no Sepal specific revenue was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses sepalai.com (name plus AI suffix); the site now returns 404.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission driven, 'advance human knowledge and capabilities with the responsible development of AI'

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself; coverage focused on the acquisition.

pivots.from: evaluation and deployment tooling (YC launch post 'Confidently deploy your AI models')
pivots.to: data development company building benchmarks and training datasets for labs
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from differing descriptions.

outcome_analysis: Sepal AI was founded by two ex Turing operators who knew the expert trainer business, entering the data market as demand from AI labs surged. It grew to about 15 people and an expert network of over 20,000, and was acquired by Mercor on February 6, 2026 for undisclosed terms. Funding is only reported on aggregators at roughly 500K to 1M dollars, so the exit looks like a consolidation of expert supply rather than a distress sale.
notes: Funding reports conflict: Seedtable pre-seed 500K (September 2024), Standout 1M seed, company page says several million dollars. All aggregator or unquantified, so no round is recorded and funding is partial. Website sepalai.com returned 404. The competitor search returned only 2025 to 2026 roundups with no 2024 dated launches, so the list is empty. Pivot is inferred from the YC launch post title versus the later description.
